note: Scripted write-then-read flows run by dual-stack-sweep.py on both stacks with realistic frontend payloads. ${name} is replaced by a value captured from an earlier step of the same stack ('capture' uses a tiny JSONPath). 'mask' lists JSONPath-lite paths ($.a.b, [0], [*]) whose values are replaced by <masked> in both responses before comparing: use it only for values that follow elapsed wall-clock time (durations, speeds), never to hide a difference. Every behavioural difference in a journey is a FAIL unless the registry accepts it.

journeys.name: personal-telex-cleanup
journeys.note: A paused previous training is finished (not deleted) when the next one is created, and feeds the statistics row with its stored duration/speed; duration and speed are sent explicitly so the figures are deterministic. admin already has statistics rows, so this exercises the increment branch. admin's type-3 row (index 3) holds the timing-derived speed that personal-telex-lifecycle left behind, so only that row's avgSpeed is masked.

journeys.name: personal-telex-fields
journeys.note: student: a missing DTO property keeps Jackson's default, an explicit null overwrites it, scalars are coerced into the String/Integer columns, a blank id means create, and a NOT_STARTED predecessor is deleted by the next creation. The student has no statistics rows yet, so the final finish exercises the full-recount branch.

journeys.name: personal-telex-cleanup-first-row
journeys.note: student has no type-2 statistics row, so the first paused-then-replaced training makes Java recount every finished training of the type (average rounded to a whole number); the second one increments the existing row.

journeys.name: personal-telex-null-duration
journeys.note: student: the Vue page creates a training without a duration, so a paused one has duration NULL. Java then fails the next creation (NumberFormatException -> 202, rolled back); Rust finishes the paused training. Both differences are registered as ACCEPTED.
